name: Wipe slider table
definition: Table with a draggable handle that wipes between the old and new versions of each row.

demo.how: The old and new versions of the same table are stacked, and the handle wipes between them row by row: left of it is the old outcome, right of it the new. Drag the handle, use the slider and arrow keys, or jump with Old and New; Reset centres it. Data is illustrative.
